description.value: You draw upon the collective's memory of polymorphing to refine your current form. You must be polymorphed to Cast this Spell. You increase the protection of your current form, but decrease its speed. For the duration, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC in your current form, but your Speed is reduced to 15 feet for all movement types.
